Do NOT re-pin P3B1. Rationale: comparator difference 0.023; tolerance 0.020; excess beyond tolerance only 0.003; development gate margin about 0.52; production-target margin about 0.17; no corresponding visible anatomical defect found; weights-only is already about 0.680; P3B1 itself compresses the same edge substantially; P3B1 had 14 development failures and materially worse associated metrics; r95 is materially better in torso maximum, volume behaviour, self-intersections and overall deformation quality; previous attempts to force this comparator value introduced genuine pull-up arm regressions. Record as an explicit owner disposition associated with r95, not as a fabricated numerical pass. Do not perform another experiment merely to eliminate this comparator difference.
